overall_logic_review.assessment: The result is logically sound. All named literature claims pass the primary-source gate. Three-track review, pane5 arbitration, implication labels, status taxonomy, and positive-control construction are explicitly project-engineered and are not attributed to the cited sources. The protocol does not claim measured effectiveness, guaranteed error detection, or ground-truth recovery. Lack of independent effectiveness measurement is therefore a disclosed method limitation, not a literature-coverage failure.

findings.title: Optional direct locator for ordinary no-outgoing State semantics
findings.assessment: PG-UML-COMPLETION-2017 is adequately supported as written. Adding clause 14.2.3.3, p. 307 and its stable-Vertex text would make the last non-converse sentence independently auditable without relying on the FinalState subclass/constraint distinction.

summary.overall_reason: All 12 named literature claims now have verified primary-source support, exact locators, quotations, and non-support boundaries. The three v1 HIGH findings are resolved. Project controls remain explicitly disclosed operationalizations whose independent effectiveness is not measured or claimed; this warrants the stated limitation but does not fail literature coverage.
